name: 98103 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98103 (Seattle) has 250 nonprofit organizations. 133 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 113 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98103 (Seattle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
